title: Vault Upsert — payload
description: Create a new vault entry or update an existing one. The secret material — if present — rides inside an HPKE-sealed envelope (see SealedSecret), so the Trust Task carries ciphertext and an authenticator, not plaintext. Updates may be partial: any populated metadata field replaces the current value; omitted fields are left untouched; explicit null clears the field (per `clearFields`). Optimistic-concurrency check via `expectedVersion`.

id.description: Entry id. Omit to create; supply to update. Maintainers MAY accept consumer-supplied ids on create (recommended: ULID) or MAY assign their own and return the assigned id in the response.

expectedVersion.description: When updating, the consumer's last-observed `version` for the entry. The maintainer rejects with `vault/upsert:version_conflict` if the current version differs. Omit on create.

contextId.description: Trust context the entry belongs to. Cannot be changed by upsert; to move an entry between contexts the consumer MUST delete and recreate.

sealedSecret.description: HPKE-sealed envelope carrying the VaultSecret cleartext (see _shared/0.1/vault-secret.schema.json). REQUIRED on create unless `secretKind` is `did-self-issued` or `didcomm-peer` (those carry only references to maintainer-internal key ids and have no extra secret bytes). On update, omit if the secret material is unchanged; populate if the secret is being rotated.

clearFields.description: List of metadata fields to explicitly clear on this upsert. Distinguishes "don't touch" (field omitted from payload) from "clear" (field listed here).

SealedSecret.title: SealedSecret
SealedSecret.description: HPKE-sealed envelope containing the VaultSecret cleartext. Format is the framework's standard sealed-transfer envelope (X25519-HKDF-SHA256 KEM + HKDF-SHA256 KDF + ChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD, OpenPGP-style ASCII armoring with Bundle-Id + Digest-Algo headers + CRC24). The Trust Task carries the armored ciphertext; the maintainer (or any party with the X25519 private key) unseals to recover the VaultSecret.

armored.description: OpenPGP-style ASCII-armored HPKE envelope. Multi-line base64 with header + CRC24 checksum.

recipientKeyId.description: Identifier of the X25519 public key the envelope was sealed to. The receiving side uses this to select the matching private key. Convention: did:key:<X25519 public-key-multibase> for VTA-facing seals.

producerAssertion.description: Which producer-assertion mode was used per the framework sealed-transfer spec. `did-signed` = Ed25519 signature by issuer; `attested` = TEE quote; `pinned-only` = OOB SHA-256 pinning (dev/test only).

created.description: true when this upsert created a new entry; false when it updated an existing one.
